{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cularin Licensing and Regulatory Bureau''' was an organization that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Bureau was responsible for issuing permits that allowed individuals to use specified restricted items while in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. It had the right to deny an application for a permit or limit the number of permits held by an individual. It could also increase the fee or waiting time for a permit if doing so was viewed as necessary for ensuring the safety of the inhabitants of the Cularin system.
